note: Geneva County has no county zoning for its rural jurisdiction (county Road & Bridge page). City of Geneva publishes its zoning ordinance and zoning map only as PDFs (genevaal.gov/ordinances); City of Slocomb publishes its zoning map only as a PDF (slocomb.s3.amazonaws.com). County Flagship GIS viewer (geneva.alabamagis.com) has parcels only; no public zoning district service found. Hartford and Samson have no official zoning GIS found. No queryable zoning district polygon layer exists in ArcGIS for the county or its cities.
